notes: ROUND 2 (2026-11-21): FIRST REAL RI/ARI/PEO PAPERS FOUND. PEO 2023: genuine PEO & Junior Assistant official paper (09 Jul 2023, CRE-2023, 180 Qs) verified at Adda247 (curl 200, 7.9 MB) plus solved SET-B and SET-D PDFs (both curl 200). RI/ARI: the CRE 2023-IV recruitment cycle's Prelims were actually held Oct-Nov 2025, so its papers are recorded under year 2025 (08 Oct 2025 Shift 3 via Testbook CDN, curl 200, 15.8 MB; 19 Oct 2025 Shift 3 via Result91, curl 200) and the Mains held 26 Apr 2026 recorded under 2026 (Result91, curl 200, 3.3 MB). Adda247 RI/ARI collection page (browser-open verified 2026-11-21) lists further 2025 shifts plus Revenue Inspector 2021 Paper 1 & 2 and 2015 papers — recorded as one 2021 collection entry. Duplicates skipped: round 1's two 2024 LI/Forester/Forest Guard PDFs are NOT RI/ARI/PEO and are not re-listed; every round-2 entry is a different post/year/URL. Official site: www.osssc.gov.in returned curl 200 once then 000 on immediate retry, and browser fetch failed (DNS/timeout) — flaky/unreachable in practice, so NO official papers listed. Still not found: any RI/ARI/PEO paper from calendar year 2022 (no 2022 paper surfaced on any source searched).
